description: Modules grouped under `libs.config`.

description: `libs/graph` owns graph-domain models built from telemetry windows and events.

description: `libs/perf` owns operational instrumentation helpers: MLflow integration; wall-time logging; memory observability snapshots; stage-manifest generation

name: Phase

name: Profiling
description: `libs/profiling` owns parameter profiling over canonical telemetry: datatype profiling; continuous scaling/profile statistics; behavior-family profiling

name: Pyspark
description: Modules grouped under `libs.pyspark`.

name: Reporting
description: Modules grouped under `libs.reporting`.
